test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MATURE' is coded as '7 26 14 22 9 6', and 'OUTPUT' is coded as '7 6 12 7 6 11'. How will 'REMOVE' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

Logic: Place value of Opposite letter and cross exchange = Code of that letter.

Now,

'MATURE' is coded as '7 26 14 22 9 6'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35230a01cdc18896df86f2e6f6895b17164aaff329716b7cf3b08447f36ba3c7.png] 

 

'OUTPUT' is coded as '7 6 12 7 6 11'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70ac7889928678b0b08c0e6c8da6786ac2972ea4757ce493c2028796a2e5787b.png] 

Similarly, for **'REMOVE'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08355a9fb2f489b44429258d75b3da7e79013797cf3750a89bee40bb4d0850c5.png] 

So,** ****'REMOVE'** will be coded as '14, 22, 9, 22, 5, 12'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
